Design BUBBLE COMET: a playful handheld bubble wand. A straight clean 10cm gripping zone near the lower end, about 4cm diameter. The front face of the loop points forward. Composition: four panels, FRONT, SIDE, TOP, and HELD. First three are clean internally consistent orthographic isolated views of exactly the same object with no character or effects; the last is a small gray simplified athletic game hand properly gripping the item at the stated zone, with a modest use-effect accent. Preserve shape across views and leave enough white space. No extra item variants, logos, text beyond panel labels/item name, no photoreal plastic gloss, no fine fragile detail. This will be modeled in Blender and mounted to either hand from one source mesh.
